articles.title: Child being airlifted to hospital after crash, eastbound Hwy. 401 closed in Pickering
articles.summary: A child has been airlifted to hospital after a single vehicle crash on Highway 401 in Pickering. Ontario Provincial Police were called to the scene at Brock Road on Thursday afternoon. ORNGE tells CityNews they are transporting one paediatric patient to the Hospital for Sick Children with critical injuries. It’s unknown if anyone else was […]

articles.title: Man dies in Markham workplace incident, Ministry of Labour investigating
articles.summary: The Ministry of Labour has been called in to investigate after a man died in a workplace incident in Markham. York police would not provide any details about how the man was injured, but say they were called to reports of an injured person in the area of McCowan Road and Highway 7 on Thursday. […]

articles.title: Man charged in voyeurism investigation after woman allegedly filmed at Oakville store
articles.summary: Halton Regional Police officers say the incident happened on July 22 at a Winners store on Winston Churchill Boulevard in Oakville.

articles.title: Man wanted for alleged sexual assault in Vaughan restaurant washroom
articles.summary: York Regional Police investigators are looking to identify a man in connection with a sexual assault in a Vaughan restaurant. Police say a male was in the washroom of the restaurant in the Keele Street and Rutherford Road area around 9 a.m. on June 25. He was approached by an unknown suspect who allegedly touched […]

articles.title: Man arrested after Toronto police officer shot in e-bike robbery investigation
articles.summary: A 27-year-old is facing several charges after allegedly shooting a police officer during a robbery attempt in downtown Toronto early Thursday morning. Police are still seeking a second suspect.

articles.title: Parallel construction projects on Carlton, Wellesley streets frustrating Toronto community
articles.summary: Ongoing construction on and around Carlton and Wellesley streets has been plaguing local residents, as partial roadway shutdowns and transit disruptions create traffic headaches.

articles.title: York police to handle criminal investigation into Sarnia's suspended police chief
articles.summary: Sarnia's police board is confirming there's a criminal investigation as it redirects questions to external agencies.

articles.title: Power restored to thousands in Toronto's east end, parts of downtown, utility says
articles.summary: Toronto Hydro says power has been restored to thousands in the city's east end and parts of downtown after an outage that lasted for hours Wednesday night.

articles.title: CEBL reverts to 1-game final after cancellation of Winnipeg-Brampton series opener
articles.summary: The Canadian Elite Basketball League is returning to a one-game championship on Saturday in Winnipeg after the opening game of a best-of-three series between the Sea Bears and hometown Brampton Honey Badgers was cancelled Wednesday night "due to condensation on the court" at Brampton's CAA Centre.

articles.title: Brampton landlord to face jail time after fire that killed pregnant woman, child in 2023
articles.summary: An Ontario landlord has been sentenced to jail time after being convicted of seven charges following a Brampton fire that left a pregnant woman and her daughter dead more than three years ago.

articles.title: Oakville becomes first Ontario municipality to enact 1-year moratorium on data centres
articles.summary: Oakville has enacted a one-year moratorium on new data centres, becoming the first Ontario municipality to take the step as local lawmakers grapple with the concerns surrounding the new wave of facilities powering artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Former Raptors coach fights Ontario over nearly $700K tax paid on multimillion-dollar home
articles.summary: Former Toronto Raptors head coach Nick Nurse and his wife are embroiled in a legal dispute with the Ontario government over its refusal to reimburse the couple nearly $700,000 in foreign buyer tax they paid on their Mississauga home.
